shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side. A woman in a cobalt blazer sits in the sideboard-side window seat and asks a question, a man in an olive sweater sits in the patio-side window seat, and a woman in a burgundy cardigan sits in the sideboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the patio-door end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The woman in the cobalt blazer in the sideboard-side window seat swaps seats with the man in the olive sweater in the patio-side window seat, who answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in the burgundy cardigan replies.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the dining table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.
